comparison.objective: Release and remove a retained graphics card; unlike tuning and locking a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous latch depression and straight card extraction versus hex-key loosening, collar rotation, counterholding, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Latch held, card removed without breakage or jamming, then placed in tray versus repeatable non-bottoming carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Both require bimanual coordination, but the tested retention-release/extraction ability is meaningfully different. No separate specs were present.
